translation: Twenty-one: Although the various places were clear, the two sides of the shoulders and neck, below the occipital bone, still seemed to have obstruction, so I concentrated on rubbing the jaw, and after a long time all four sides were drawn and moved. The three yang channels cross from the hands to the shoulders, go behind the ears, come out above the ears, turn back at the jaw, descend to Daying, enter Renying, and reach Quepen. Shaoyang goes to the occipital bone and comes out in front of the ear; taiyang comes out in the jaw; yangming goes to the lower corner of the jaw.
